title.en: Who takes the notes this quarter

text.en: Light workload this month and writes clear summaries, but is away on leave for two of the next six weeks.
text.hinglish: Is mahine kaam kam hai aur summaries saaf likhte hain, par agle chhe hafton mein se do hafte chhutti par hain.

text.en: Just finished a big delivery and has free afternoons, though past notes ran long and missed the decisions.
text.hinglish: Abhi ek bada delivery khatam hua hai aur dopahar khaali hain, par pichhle notes lambe the aur faisle chhoot gaye.

text.en: Already takes notes for one weekly meeting, steady workload, knows the project well and types fast.
text.hinglish: Ek weekly meeting ke notes pehle se likhte hain, kaam steady hai, project achhe se jaante hain aur typing tez hai.

text.en: Tied up with a client launch until month end, but sharp at catching action points when in the room.
text.hinglish: Mahine ke ant tak client launch mein vyast hain, par room mein hon to action points turant pakad lete hain.

continuation.en: {first} gets the largest share of the notes rota, and the rota goes up on the team board.
continuation.hinglish: {first} ko notes rota ka sabse bada hissa milta hai, aur rota team board par lag jaata hai.

text.en: Quiet month with few deadlines and good with vendors, but has never handled a budget above a small petty cash float.
text.hinglish: Mahina shaant hai, deadlines kam hain, vendors ke saath achha kaam karte hain, par bada budget kabhi nahi sambhala.

text.en: Heavy workload until the audit closes, very organised, and ran last year's event without a single complaint.
text.hinglish: Audit band hone tak kaam bahut hai, bahut organised hain, aur pichhle saal ka event bina kisi shikayat ke chalaya.

text.en: Moderate workload, new to the team and keen to meet people, though unfamiliar with the usual venues and caterers.
text.hinglish: Kaam theek-thaak hai, team mein naye hain aur logon se milna chahte hain, par aam venues aur caterers se parichit nahi hain.

text.en: Covering for a colleague on leave, so stretched, but already in touch with the caterer through another project.
text.hinglish: Chhutti par gaye colleague ka kaam sambhal rahe hain, isliye vyast hain, par doosre project se caterer ke sampark mein hain.

continuation.en: {first} takes the largest share of the party list, and the checklist goes round on Monday.
continuation.hinglish: {first} ko party list ka sabse bada hissa milta hai, aur checklist Somvaar ko sabko bheji jaati hai.

title.en: Who orders lunch for client visits
title.hinglish: Client visits ka lunch kaun order karega

text.en: Sits near the entrance and knows the clients' diets and tastes, but has back-to-back calls on most visit days.
text.hinglish: Entrance ke paas baithte hain aur clients ki diet aur pasand jaante hain, par zyadatar visit dinon par lagataar calls hoti hain.

text.en: Free on most visit days and reliable with orders, though new enough that the clients' preferences are unknown.
text.hinglish: Zyadatar visit dinon par khaali hain aur orders mein bharosemand hain, par naye hone se clients ki pasand abhi maloom nahi hai.

text.en: Moderate load and has handled client lunches twice before, but is travelling for two of the next four visits.
text.hinglish: Kaam theek-thaak hai aur do baar client lunch sambhala hai, par agle chaar visits mein se do par safar mein hain.

text.en: Heavy month with a report due, careful with details such as allergies, and already holds the company card.
text.hinglish: Report due hone se mahina bhaari hai, allergies jaise details mein saavdhan rehte hain, aur company card pehle se unke paas hai.

continuation.en: {first} receives the largest share of the client lunches, and the vendor list is handed over.
continuation.hinglish: {first} ko client lunches ka sabse bada hissa milta hai, aur vendor list saunp di jaati hai.

title.en: Who keeps the shared calendar up to date

text.en: Steady desk work all day and tidy with dates, but sometimes forgets to tell people about changes.
text.hinglish: Din bhar desk par steady kaam hai aur dates mein saaf-suthre hain, par badlaav batana kabhi kabhi bhool jaate hain.

text.en: Light workload before the next sprint and quick with calendar tools, though often out on site visits.
text.hinglish: Agle sprint se pehle kaam halka hai aur calendar tools mein tez hain, par aksar site visits par bahar rehte hain.

text.en: Already runs the leave tracker so knows everyone's dates, but is now close to a deadline on a proposal.
text.hinglish: Leave tracker pehle se sambhalte hain, isliye sabki dates jaante hain, par ab ek proposal ki deadline paas hai.

text.en: Few meetings this quarter and learns tools fast, though a booking clash slipped through once before.
text.hinglish: Is quarter meetings kam hain aur tools jaldi seekhte hain, par ek baar booking clash nazar se nikal gaya tha.

continuation.en: {first} is handed the largest share of the calendar upkeep, and the owner column is updated.
continuation.hinglish: {first} ko calendar upkeep ka sabse bada hissa milta hai, aur owner column update ho jaata hai.

text.en: Steady workload and trained in the HR forms, but already manages the visitor register and a weekly report.
text.hinglish: Kaam steady hai aur HR forms ki training mili hai, par visitor register aur ek weekly report pehle se sambhalte hain.

text.en: Quiet fortnight ahead and patient with first-timers, though unfamiliar with the ID and access forms.
text.hinglish: Agla pakhwada shaant hai aur naye logon ke saath dhairya rakhte hain, par ID aur access forms se parichit nahi hain.

text.en: Near a release date and busy, but mentored last year's interns and knows where the paperwork stalls.
text.hinglish: Release date paas hai aur vyast hain, par pichhle saal interns ko guide kiya tha aur jaante hain paperwork kahan atakta hai.

text.en: Moderate load with flexible hours, good at checking details, and sits close to the HR desk.
text.hinglish: Kaam theek-thaak hai, samay lachila hai, details jaanchne mein achhe hain, aur HR desk ke paas baithte hain.

continuation.en: {first} receives the largest share of the intern files, and the checklist is shared with HR.
continuation.hinglish: {first} ko intern files ka sabse bada hissa milta hai, aur checklist HR ke saath share ho jaati hai.
